identity.name: Domain Credential Theft via ntdsutil Shadow Copy
identity.summary: An attacker uses ntdsutil or vssadmin to create a shadow copy and extract ntds.dit and SYSTEM hives for credential theft. Cortex should detect this behavior as a suspicious dump of ntds.dit using shad
identity.description: An attacker uses ntdsutil or vssadmin to create a shadow copy and extract ntds.dit and SYSTEM hives for credential theft. Cortex should detect this behavior as a suspicious dump of ntds.dit using shadow copy.

payload.code:
vssadmin create shadow /for=C:
ntdsutil.exe activate instance ntds
create state
quit
quit
vssadmin list shadows
vssadmin delete shadows /shadow={GUID}

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Shadow Copy Creation with ntdsutil or vssadmin
biocs.description: Detection of vssadmin or ntdsutil being used to create a shadow copy for credential theft
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter (actor_process_image_name = 'ntdsutil.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe')
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'create shadow'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'ntds'

abiocs.name: Suspicious dump of ntds.dit using Shadow Copy with ntdsutil or vssadmin
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating use of shadow copy to extract ntds.dit for credential theft
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'ntdsutil.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'create shadow'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'ntds'
| filter action_file_path contains '\\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for ntdsutil or vssadmin shadow copy creation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter (actor_process_image_name = 'ntdsutil.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe')
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'create shadow'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'ntds'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_command_line, action_file_path
